note: Family-owned park at 1501 N. Osage Blvd, Nevada, beside I-49 and Highway 54, open year round: 46 full-hookup 30/50-amp pull-through sites, some shaded, with picnic tables and fire pits. Showers, a 24-hour laundry, a general store with RV supplies, propane, a playground, a seasonal pool, and horse stalls and a corral for guests travelling with horses. --Claude
summary: Confirmed private gates: $40 (30A) / $45 (50A) full hookups posted on the operator's page and sold one night on RoverPass for Nov 2026; added 46 sites (operator map), flush toilets/Wi-Fi/propane/pool, RoverPass request-to-book with a 2-month window. Passes all five long-stay tests. Not waterfront kept.
flags: GATE FACTS: posted rate $40 (30A) / $45 (50A) plus tax on the operator's own rates page, confirmed by RoverPass one-night prices for 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-21 (under $50, no gateway needed); Good Sam directory gs false (not a Good Sam Park), military true; presence: own site osageprairie.com (Wix) with phone 417-667-2267 + claimed, bookable RoverPass listing. Google Maps 4.4 stars from 194 reviews (well above the 4.0 line); RV Life 4.5 from 123, $$, average $38.

LONG-STAY (weekly $240/$270 and monthly-on-request marketed): (1) $40-45 under $50 - pass; (2) nightly rate on the operator's own page with phone, and RoverPass sells one night with no application, lease or approval beyond the park confirming the request - pass; (3) minimum 1 night (minNightsRequired '1') - pass; (4) no count of nightly vs monthly sites anywhere, all 46 are priced nightly - pass; (5) no homes or lots sold - pass. OCCUPANCY: RoverPass here is request-to-book without site inventory (isInventory false), so no free-site count exists; both November dates offered every rate. The five newest Google/Tripadvisor reviews read are all from travellers passing through ('Pretty easy on/off Hwy 49', 'found this campground last minute while dealing with RV troubles', 'Highly recommend if you get a chance to pass through', 'We have stayed here for 2 times over the past 2 years'); none mentions residents. Read as a transient highway park with a weekly option - keep.

DISCOUNTS (not written): military true from the Good Sam directory is corroborated by the operator ('ask about Military, Police and Fire / Rescue Discounts') and RoverPass's military/first-responder rate $5 under the standard one.
WEBSITE: osageprairie.com is the operator's (its park map also names CampThePrairie.com). Keep the RoverPass link - it is claimed and bookable. Phone 417-667-2267 matches every operator page.
PIN 37.8533,-94.3457 sits at the clubhouse/entrance, ~50-70 m east of the site rows - fine. Waterfront: none on imagery; 'not waterfront' kept.
